feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 28 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southeast 5 to 7, veering west 5 or 6 late afternoon, then decreasing southwest 4 or 5 early night.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate in the morning, occasionally touching rough in the northeast in the afternoon.


##Weather)##

Rain late morning until early evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 for a time in the morning.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the morning.


##Weather)##

Showers in the morning.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Monday, 30 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds developing.


##Wind)##

South or Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 7 or gale 8.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough, then generally rough later.


##Weather)##

Rain gradually spreading from the northwest.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tuesday, 1 December 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds at first.


##Wind)##

South or Southwest 7 or gale 8, but veering and decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5.


##State of sea)##

Rough, falling slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Rain clearing.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, becoming good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
